title: fix(plugin-email): Send test with "None (log only)" picked but not saved no longer delivers over the live SMTP
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuACdPWFJTLDcTrByFCHLzqb)_

Fixes #25509

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What was wrong
Setup → Email's "Send test email" (the `mail/test` handler in `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-plugin.ts`) tests the form's merged values, saved or not: `smtp` builds a one-shot `SmtpTransport`, Resend / Postmark build a one-shot service. `provider === 'log'` matched neither branch, so `target` stayed the LIVE service. With SMTP live and "None (log only — no real delivery)" picked on the form but not saved, the press delivered a real mail and answered `ok: true` "Sent test email to …".

## The change
- New `provider === 'log'` branch: when the live transport is not already a `LogTransport`, the test goes through a one-shot `EmailService` over a new `LogTransport`, with the same `persistence` option as the smtp branch (the press is still recorded in `sys_email`). When the live transport already IS a `LogTransport` (a saved `log`, or the out-of-the-box namespace), the target stays the live service and the answer is the existing saved-`log` warning, unchanged.
- The answer for the unsaved-`log` press uses the saved-`log` answer's severity and words (`ok: false`, `severity: 'warning'`, "only logged and recorded in sys_email"), the banner's phrase for a log-only transport ("no mail left this machine"), and names the live transport it did not use, so the two doors agree:
  `Nothing was delivered — the provider on the form is "None (log only)", so the test message was only logged and recorded in sys_email; no mail left this machine. The live transport was not used (Mail is delivered through SMTP (smtp.saved.test:587)); save the form to stop delivery.`
- The other providers' branch is the old `provider !== 'log'` body, untouched (it became the `else`).
- Landing: the file the claim names. `packages/spec` is not touched.

## Tests
`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/mail-log-provider.pin.test.ts` gains a describe block (its harness's `sendTest` now takes an optional unsaved form state, posted as `payload.values`, as the page does):
- SMTP saved on the page and live, form provider `log`: `nodemailer.sendMail` is never called; the answer is `ok: false` / `warning`, starts "Nothing was delivered", says "no mail left this machine" and names `SMTP (smtp.saved.test:587)`; the live transport is still the `SmtpTransport` afterwards.
- SMTP built at boot from the boot options (`OS_EMAIL_SMTP_*` as `providerOptions`), form provider `log`: no `sendMail`, same answer shape.
- CONTROL: form provider `smtp` with a host still sends (`sendMail` once, `ok: true`, "Sent test email to admin@example.test via smtp (smtp.form.test:587)").

Fixture re-judged: two pins in `email-plugin.queue-delivery.test.ts` ("mail/test is never queued") pressed the button with form provider `log` to reach the harness's host transport, which is exactly the behaviour this PR removes. They now press with an SMTP host on the form, faking only nodemailer's wire (`sendMail` resolves; `sendMail` rejects with `535 5.7.8`), and keep every assertion they had (inline answer from the transport, no `sys_job_queue` job, audit row finalized `sent`). A third leg keeps the queue invariant on the LIVE service: a live `LogTransport` with queue delivery on answers the warning inline, with no job.

Runs (head `79a4642ce8`, after merging `origin/main`; the merge brought no plugin-email path):
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email test`: Test Files 38 passed (38), Tests 689 passed (689).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, then `check:test-typecheck: OK`).

**Ablation** (head `2485802f70`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): the anchor `if (!(svc.options.transport instanceof LogTransport)) {` was replaced by `if (false /* ABLATION-25509 */) {`. The tool reported "ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob a4f67d1b9e86 -> 6d31a251e7e3". The pin went RED: Tests 2 failed | 6 passed (8), both unsaved-`log` legs failing on "expected vi.fn() to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times" (the live SMTP sent), with the CONTROL and the saved-`log` pins holding. The restore reported "ok restored: blob == HEAD (a4f67d1b9e86) and `git diff HEAD` is empty". The test imports `./email-plugin.js` from `src`, so no `dist` leg applies.

## Gates
`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `79a4642ce8` derives 67 commands; all 67 ran locally with their exit codes recorded. `--ran` says: "67 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 66 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".
- NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it reads built output of every package; this worktree built only plugin-email's closure). CI's Build Core / Lint lanes carry it.
- The CI-only families (Test Core, Build Core, the type-check lanes, artifact rosters) are read from this PR's check-runs.

## Acceptance notes
- The handler's own doc comment already says a one-shot temporary service is built when the form differs from the live one; the `log` branch now honours it.
